threepl.exec

Class SubField

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.exec.SubField
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Constant

    public class SubField
extends java.lang.Object
implements Constant
    This class is a subscript or field descriptor. This is used for subscript/field descriptor lists and can be -
    • a missing subscript - type SFType.NULL
    • a single immediate subscript - type SFType.IMSUB
    • an immediate subscript range - type SFType.IMSUBS
    • a target subscript expression - type SFType.TARSUB
    • a field name - type SFType.FIELD

    • Constructor Detail

      • SubField

        public SubField(Node n1,
                Node n2,
                boolean sub,
                SrcLoc l)
        Construct a subscript/field descriptor from one or two Nodes, n1 and n2.
        • If evaluation of 'n1' gives an integer, it is the lower or only subscript.
        • If evaluation of 'n1' gives a string, it is a field name.
        • If evaluation of 'n2' gives an integer, it is the upper subscript for a range, otherwise 'n2' is null.
        • If both 'n1' and 'n2' are null then this is a missing subscript for which the full dimension will be used.
        Parameters:
        n1 - is the first or only subscript or field string
        n2 - is the upper subscript of a range or else null
        sub - is true if this is from subscript syntax [...]
        l - is the source file location

      • SubField

        public SubField(int n1,
                int n2,
                SrcLoc l)
        Construct a subscript descriptor from one or two integers, n1 and n2. If n2 is 0, n1 is a single subscript, otherwise n1 and n2 are a subscript range
        Parameters:
        n1 - is the first or only subscript
        n2 - is the upper subscript of a range or else 0
        l - is the source file location
